resources.string: Add, configure, sign in and update book sources
Add a JSON source by URL, local file or pasted text. Plugin packages (.lnrp / APK) cannot be added here.
No added sources yet. Add one to read from more sites.
Allowed site origins, one per line
Only authorize sites this source needs. Include the scheme and optional port. Requests to other sites or private network addresses are denied.
Validate and restore the previous revision with the displayed site permissions. Your books and reading progress keep their identities.
Remove this source from online reading. Saved books, progress and readable offline content remain; other sources are unaffected.
Sign in again to continue using this source.
Continue to the source login page. Finish login to return, or cancel to discard this attempt.
This definition is disabled. Enable it in the source file before importing.
Allow the selected update to change its source address while keeping my books linked to this source.
Approve permissions and apply selected sources
Some entries cannot be imported. Review the preview before selecting valid entries.
The action failed. Check the input and permissions, then retry.
The source rule could not run. Review its definition or sign in again.
A required site has not been authorized.
The site resolved to a private or reserved address. If your VPN uses Fake-IP, use real DNS (such as redir-host) or try a direct connection. Adding site permissions will not resolve this.
The site name could not be resolved. Check your connection, DNS and source address, then retry.
Use a direct connection or VPN/TUN with real DNS. Fake-IP and Wi-Fi/system HTTP proxies are not currently supported.
The revision was not activated. The installed source remains available; review and retry the update.
This source has no update URL. Import a newer file or paste its updated definition.
Source removed. Saved books and reading records remain.
